body: Due dates on checklist items (T-323, gated per account T-327), the shared colour scheme (T-324), invite fixes (T-322), the review follow-ups since 3.2.0 (T-327), server fuzzing and routing fixes (T-326), e-mail Unicode folding with migration 12 (T-328), screenshot tests (T-325), gittoc 0.9.0 (T-329).
